name: footer-wordmark-rise
title: Footer Wordmark Rise
description: A dark site footer that rises into view over a glow swelling off the bottom edge, closed by a giant wordmark fitted to the column whose letters climb out of their masks one by one.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/block/footer-wordmark-rise
GSAP plugins (ScrollTrigger, SplitText) are registered inside the component, so there is nothing to set up.
The wordmark is sized from the column, not from a font size, so any brand name spans the footer edge to edge. Pass your own `columns`, `socials` and `legal` links.
